problem_statement: RIOT must provide a compile-time helper HAS_ALIGNMENT_OF(addr, alignment) that can be used in static assertions. It should evaluate to 1 when the address given by addr is aligned to the given alignment and to 0 otherwise, with alignment being a power of two. It must work for pointer-like arguments, e.g. HAS_ALIGNMENT_OF((void *)8, 8) is true and HAS_ALIGNMENT_OF((void *)7, 8) is false.
